products.name: Recraft
products.note: Vector image generation; brand consistency; commercial design; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Recraft describes itself as a top-ranked text-to-image model and design platform aimed at designers, creatives, sellers, and teams. The platform covers photorealism, vector generation, custom styles, and mockups, and allows users to generate and edit images using both Recraft's own models and other frontier models. The site also highlights a custom style feature, through which users can upload their own images and have them converted into a reusable, editable style for brand consistency.

The held facts record Recraft's core product under the image and graphic design category, noting capabilities in vector image generation, brand consistency, and commercial design, with the service described as UK-hosted. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
